title: Buses and People
statementMd:
The main Bertown street is represented by a straight line. There are $10^{9}$ bus stops located on the line. The stops are numbered with integers from $1$ to $10^{9}$ in the order in which they follow on the road. The city has $*n*$ buses. Every day the $*i*$-th bus drives from stop number $*s*_{*i*}$ to stop number $*f*_{*i*}$ ($*s*_{*i*} < *f*_{*i*}$), it stops on all intermediate stops and returns only at night. The bus starts driving at time $*t*_{*i*}$ and drives so fast that it finishes driving also at time $*t*_{*i*}$. The time $*t*_{*i*}$ is different for all buses. The buses have infinite capacity.

Bertown has $*m*$ citizens. Today the $*i*$-th person should get from stop number $*l*_{*i*}$ to stop number $*r*_{*i*}$ ($*l*_{*i*} < *r*_{*i*}$); the $*i*$-th citizen comes to his initial stop ($*l*_{*i*}$) at time $*b*_{*i*}$. Each person, on the one hand, wants to get to the destination point as quickly as possible, and on the other hand, definitely does not want to change the buses as he rides. More formally: the $*i*$-th person chooses bus $*j*$, with minimum time $*t*_{*j*}$, such that $*s*_{*j*} ≤ *l*_{*i*}$, $*r*_{*i*} ≤ *f*_{*j*}$ and $*b*_{*i*} ≤ *t*_{*j*}$.

Your task is to determine for each citizen whether he can ride to the destination point today and if he can, find the number of the bus on which the citizen will ride.

## Input

The first line contains two integers $*n*$ and $*m*$ ($1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 10^{5}$) — the number of buses and the number of people.

Then $*n*$ lines follow, each of them contains three integers: $*s*_{*i*}$, $*f*_{*i*}$, $*t*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *s*_{*i*}, *f*_{*i*}, *t*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}, *s*_{*i*} < *f*_{*i*}$) — the description of the buses. It is guaranteed that all $*t*_{*i*}$-s are different.

Then $*m*$ lines follow, each of them contains three integers: $*l*_{*i*}$, $*r*_{*i*}$, $*b*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *l*_{*i*}, *r*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}, *l*_{*i*} < *r*_{*i*}$) — the Bertown citizens' description. Some $*b*_{*i*}$-s could coincide.

## Output

In the first line print $*m*$ space-separated integers: the $*i*$-th number should be equal either to -1, if the person number $*i*$ can't get to the destination point, or to the number of the bus that will ride the person number $*i*$. The buses are numbered with integers from $1$ to $*n*$ in the input order.
statementZhMd:
Bertown 的主干道可以表示为一条直线。直线上有 $10^{9}$ 个公交车站。车站按照它们在道路上的顺序，编号为从 $1$ 到 $10^{9}$ 的整数。城市中有 $*n*$ 辆公交车。每天，第 $*i*$ 辆公交车从编号为 $*s*_{*i*}$ 的车站开往编号为 $*f*_{*i*}$ 的车站（$*s*_{*i*} < *f*_{*i*}$），会在所有中间车站停靠，并且只有在夜间才返回。公交车在时间 $*t*_{*i*}$ 开始行驶，并且由于行驶速度极快，也会在时间 $*t*_{*i*}$ 完成行驶。所有公交车的时间 $*t*_{*i*}$ 互不相同。公交车的容量无限。

Bertown 有 $*m*$ 位居民。今天，第 $*i*$ 个人需要从编号为 $*l*_{*i*}$ 的车站前往编号为 $*r*_{*i*}$ 的车站（$*l*_{*i*} < *r*_{*i*}$）；第 $*i*$ 位居民在时间 $*b*_{*i*}$ 到达他的起点（$*l*_{*i*}$）。每个人一方面希望尽快到达目的地，另一方面在乘车过程中绝对不希望换乘。更正式地说：第 $*i*$ 个人会选择满足 $*s*_{*j*} ≤ *l*_{*i*}$、$*r*_{*i*} ≤ *f*_{*j*}$ 且 $*b*_{*i*} ≤ *t*_{*j*}$ 的公交车 $*j*$，并且所选公交车的时间 $*t*_{*j*}$ 最小。

你的任务是确定每位居民今天是否能够乘车到达目的地；如果可以，找出该居民乘坐的公交车编号。

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*m*$（$1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 10^{5}$）——公交车和居民的数量。

接下来 $*n*$ 行，每行包含三个整数：$*s*_{*i*}$、$*f*_{*i*}$、$*t*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *s*_{*i*}, *f*_{*i*}, *t*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}, *s*_{*i*} < *f*_{*i*}$）——公交车的描述。保证所有 $*t*_{*i*}$ 互不相同。

接下来 $*m*$ 行，每行包含三个整数：$*l*_{*i*}$、$*r*_{*i*}$、$*b*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *l*_{*i*}, *r*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}, *l*_{*i*} < *r*_{*i*}$）——Bertown 居民的描述。某些 $*b*_{*i*}$ 可能相同。

## 输出格式

第一行输出 $*m*$ 个用空格分隔的整数：第 $*i*$ 个数应当等于 -1（如果第 $*i*$ 个人无法到达目的地），或者等于第 $*i*$ 个人将要乘坐的公交车编号。公交车按照输入顺序编号为从 $1$ 到 $*n*$ 的整数。
